pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal to stellate geometries with highly irregular, serrated perimeters. Edge gradients are moderately sharp on the neck, becoming increasingly diffuse and lower-contrast on the mid-flank and rump.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-pigmented pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, displaying significant widening on the lower ventral flank and narrowing as they approach the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the cervical spine, characterized by dark, erect hair clusters.

other_distinctive_markers: Terminal tail tuft is partially visible on the right lateral margin, displaying a dense cluster of dark-pigmented terminal hairs.
